threshold_source: Unchanged protocol-v4 min_pad_normal_n; event label, not a new success threshold.
origin_epoch: qpos/qvel before solve i; latest available solved contact is i-1. Forecast target state and solved contact at i+h.
contact_predictor: Persist the last completed pair-load label for both baselines.
aggregation: Each whole episode separately; overlapping windows are correlated diagnostics, not independent trials or held-out validation. No training partition.
scope: Offline descriptive analysis of existing synthetic data. No causal response, policy improvement, hardware validation, training or new physics.
